visualizerParams.title: Bug Squasher: 15 says Fizz
visualizerParams.problemDescription: In the list the number 15 shows Fizz and never FizzBuzz. The test for the multiples of 3 comes before the test for both.

solution.explanation: The tests run from top to bottom and stop at the first match. 15 is a multiple of 3, so it matched Fizz and never reached the FizzBuzz test. The most specific test goes first.

checks.label: The list is right
checks.expr: text('#out') === '1 2 Fizz 4 Buzz Fizz 7 8 Fizz Buzz 11 Fizz 13 14 FizzBuzz'
